items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: he introduced me to Charlie Creath. And Charlie Creath in turn asked me, he said, 'Are you working?'

ctx.x: He played piano. Oh, (unintelligible) and he really played but didn't read a lick. He didn't read nothing, just played. He played something, he really played. He played with Charlie Creath and everything. So, --
